name: Open Source Application Engineering
description: Work on an open-source application you have not seen before, from inspection through a verified run.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the file the change or diagnosis depends on.
See the application layout before changing it.
Find the code, docs, or config the task names.
Run a command the project files or the host evidence justify.
Find official documentation for this software.
Read the official page a search result named.
Run the project tests after a code change.

validation.rule: The application was inspected before any edit, the build command came from the project files, and the run was verified. No product-specific skill was required.
